name: cancel_demo
description: Cancel one scheduled customer demo and update the external scheduling record after an explicit human review step.

demo_id.description: Stable identifier for the scheduled demo that will be cancelled.

reason.description: Human-readable reason that will be recorded with the cancellation.

side_effects: Changes the scheduled demo status in the external system.

error_contract.next_action: Refresh the current demo state and retry only if still scheduled
